questions.prompt: A partner redeems an Entra B2B invitation successfully but cannot manage the Azure resource group they are meant to administer. No resource role has been assigned. What is missing?

options.text: An appropriate Azure RBAC assignment at the intended scope.
options.explanation: Invitation redemption establishes identity, not resource-management permission.
Directory-wide administration is unnecessary for this resource group task.

options.text: A new internal account with a shared password.
options.explanation: B2B supports using the partner's existing identity.

options.text: Change the guest display name to the resource group name.

questions.prompt: Your tenant must control which partner-tenant users and applications may access your resources through B2B collaboration. Which cross-tenant direction governs that incoming access?

options.explanation: They govern external identities entering your resource tenant.
Outbound governs your users accessing external organizations.

options.text: Only an external-collaboration invitation domain allowlist.
options.explanation: Invitation domain filtering is separate from the requested partner user/application inbound access control.

options.text: Only the partner's group display-name policy.
options.explanation: Naming groups does not configure your tenant's inbound B2B access.

questions.prompt: A partner domain is allowed in external collaboration settings, but a cross-tenant B2B rule blocks the requested access. Does the invitation allowlist override that block?

options.text: No; the relevant cross-tenant access policy must also permit access.
options.explanation: Invitation restrictions and resource access policies are separate checks.

options.text: Yes; an allowed invitation always overrides every access control.
options.explanation: Inviting a guest does not bypass other security policy.

options.text: Yes, if the guest owns any group.
options.explanation: Group ownership does not universally bypass cross-tenant restrictions.

options.text: Yes, if the usage location matches.
options.explanation: A licensing property does not override B2B policy.
